title: He Turned $53,000 Into $48 Million #shorts
description:
In 2021, a regular guy known as Roaring Kitty bet on a dying video game store, took on hedge funds and shook Wall Street. The GameStop story.
Follow for more stories of fortunes made and lost.
first_comment: Would you have held GameStop at $400, or sold and walked away rich? 👇

lines.text: In twenty nineteen, a man put fifty-three thousand dollars into a dying video game store.
Two years later, his bet was worth forty-eight million.
His name was Keith Gill, an ordinary guy posting videos as Roaring Kitty.
Everyone said GameStop was finished, and hedge funds bet billions against it.
But more shares had been sold short than the company actually had.
He posted his bets online, and thousands of strangers followed.
In January twenty twenty-one, the stock exploded from eighteen dollars to four hundred and eighty-three.
Hedge fund Melvin Capital lost more than half its money in one month.
It needed a two billion seven hundred fifty million dollar rescue.
Congress called Gill to testify. His answer: I like the stock.
One guy with a laptop had shaken Wall Street.
